response.overview: In the school hallway, Anita excitedly tells Chloe that she plans to confess her feelings to Antoni after school. Later, Anita goes to the garden gazebo and is devastated to find Antoni close to Bianca, who is holding Anita's personal love letter. Amidst a sudden thunderstorm, Bianca mocks Anita from afar and embraces Antoni, causing Anita to flee in tears. A flashback reveals that years prior, a science fair project built by Anita and Bianca malfunctioned and exploded in front of a laughing crowd, leading a humiliated Bianca to tear off her matching necklace and blame Anita for ruining her. In the present day, Bianca corners Anita in the school bathroom to confront her about the past. During the heated argument, Bianca admits her deep insecurity and resentment over the science fair disaster. Seeking closure, Anita offers Bianca the "B" necklace she has kept for years, but Bianca refuses it and walks out, leaving Anita alone with her reflection and unresolved tension.
response.title: Letters
